accepted.s: The National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) was established in which year?
accepted.x: NBCFDC was established in 1992. It is associated with financing development activities for backward classes.
accepted.tq: Use the year-based numerical recall approach and distinguish the three development finance corporations.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The NBCFDC functions under which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: NBCFDC functions under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘which ministry?’ trap by matching the institution with its beneficiary group and administrative department.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with reference to NBCFDC schemes?

1. New Swarnima — Women beneficiaries
2. Saksham — Young professionals
3. Virasat — Artisans

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: New Swarnima is intended for women and Saksham for young professionals. Virasat loans are associated with NMDFC and artisans, so statement 3 is incorrect in this context.
accepted.tq: Split the options by identifying the institution-specific scheme before checking the beneficiary group.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the National Minorities Development and Finance Corporation (NMDFC)?
o: A cooperative society under the Ministry of Finance
A Section 8 company under the Ministry of Minority Affairs
A statutory corporation under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs
A constitutional body under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: NMDFC is a Section 8 company under the Ministry of Minority Affairs.
accepted.tq: Test the exact institutional status and ministry rather than relying on the general word ‘corporation’.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding NMDFC credit lines:

1. Credit Line-1 is available for families with income up to Rs 3 lakh.
2. Credit Line-2 is available for families with income up to Rs 8 lakh.
3. Term loans may extend up to Rs 20-30 lakh.
4. The funding pattern is 90:5:5.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: NMDFC Credit Line-1 has an income ceiling of Rs 3 lakh and Credit Line-2 of Rs 8 lakh. Term loans extend up to Rs 20-30 lakh and the stated funding pattern is 90:5:5.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement independently; the complete combination is correct.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT listed as an additional NMDFC loan category?
o: Housing loans for all urban households
accepted.x: NMDFC provides education loans, micro-finance and Virasat loans for artisans. Housing loans for all urban households are not listed among the stated NMDFC loan categories.
accepted.tq: Find the option that falls outside the institution-specific list instead of selecting a generally plausible welfare activity.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Through which agencies do NBCFDC and NMDFC primarily channel their loans?
accepted.x: Both NBCFDC and NMDFC lend through State Channelising Agencies.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between financial channelling agencies and local administrative bodies.
accepted.sec: Credit institutions - NBCFDC, NMDFC - loan schemes and channelling agencies  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes PMJVK?
o: It is a Central Sector Scheme limited to minority students pursuing higher education.
It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for area development in minority concentration areas.
It is a constitutional programme implemented by the Election Commission.
It is a State scheme restricted to urban minority households.
accepted.x: PMJVK is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme aimed at area development in minority concentration areas.
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme from its funding pattern and broad area-development objective.
accepted.sec: Area development for minorities - Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram, minority concentration areas  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
PMJVK covers which of the following combination of areas in its stated coverage?

1. 870 minority concentration blocks
2. 321 towns
3. All districts, including 112 Aspirational Districts

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The stated coverage includes 870 minority concentration blocks and 321 towns, and has been extended to all districts, including 112 Aspirational Districts.
accepted.tq: Combine coverage figures with the later geographical expansion instead of treating them as alternatives.
accepted.sec: Area development for minorities - Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram, minority concentration areas  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Under PMJVK, what proportion of funds is earmarked for education, health and skills together?
accepted.x: Eighty percent of PMJVK funds go to education, health and skills.
accepted.tq: Separate the overall sectoral allocation from the distinct allocation intended for women.
accepted.sec: Area development for minorities - Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram, minority concentration areas  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The allocation under PMJVK for women is stated to be in the range of:
accepted.x: The allocation for women under PMJVK is stated to be 33-40 percent.
accepted.tq: Read the range precisely and avoid reversing it with the 80 percent sectoral allocation.
accepted.sec: Area development for minorities - Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram, minority concentration areas  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871, in relation to Denotified Tribes, was:
accepted.x: Denotified Tribes had been branded under the Criminal Tribes Act, 1871, which was repealed in 1952.
accepted.tq: Pair the historical enactment with its repeal year and beware of confusing repeal with replacement.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which commission was the first to examine the condition of Denotified Tribes among the commissions mentioned below?
accepted.x: The Renke Commission, whose report was submitted in 2008, was the first such commission mentioned for Denotified Tribes.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘first’ marker to distinguish the earlier Renke Commission from the later Idate Commission.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Idate Commission functioned during which period?
accepted.x: The Idate Commission functioned during 2014-17.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the commission’s period from the Renke Commission’s 2008 report and the SEED launch year.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the findings associated with the Idate Commission:

1. About 1,200 DNTs were already included in SC, ST or OBC lists.
2. About 267-268 DNTs had never been classified.
3. All DNTs were found to be included in the Scheduled Tribe list.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Commission found about 1,200 DNTs already in SC/ST/OBC lists and 267-268 never classified. It did not find that all DNTs were included in the Scheduled Tribe list.
accepted.tq: Reject the absolute statement and retain the two specific numerical findings.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Which of the following is the correct combination regarding the SEED scheme?

1. It was launched in 2022.
2. Its stated outlay is Rs 200 crore.
3. It covers coaching, health insurance, livelihoods and housing.
4. The income ceiling is below Rs 2.5 lakh.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: SEED was launched in 2022 with an outlay of Rs 200 crore, an income criterion below Rs 2.5 lakh, and provisions for coaching, health insurance, livelihoods and housing.
accepted.tq: Verify the year, amount, eligibility and objective separately before choosing the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: What amount was reportedly spent under SEED in five years?
accepted.x: Only Rs 69.3 crore was spent in five years, against the stated Rs 200 crore outlay, reportedly because States did not issue DNT certificates.
accepted.tq: Distinguish actual expenditure from the sanctioned or announced outlay.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The principal reason cited for the low expenditure under SEED was that:
o: States did not issue DNT certificates
the scheme covered only urban areas
the Union Government withdrew the scheme
beneficiaries were excluded from health insurance
accepted.x: Low expenditure was attributed to the failure of States to issue certificates for Denotified Tribes.
accepted.tq: Link the implementation shortfall to the administrative bottleneck rather than to the scheme’s objectives.
accepted.sec: Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes - SEED scheme, Idate Commission  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: According to the stated data, what proportion of Andhra Pradesh’s population comprises Backward Classes?
accepted.x: Backward Classes constitute 43.17 percent of Andhra Pradesh’s population according to the stated data.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact percentage and distinguish it from the separate 33.33 percent reservation figure.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Backward Classes in Andhra Pradesh are organised into how many communities and groups, respectively?
accepted.x: The AP Backward Classes are stated to comprise 138 communities organised into Groups A-E.
accepted.tq: Keep the community count separate from the number of hostels and the number of groups.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding BC welfare infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh is correct?

1. There are 747 BC hostels.
2. The Swarnakara Welfare and Development Corporation has been set up.
3. The EWS department brings together only BC corporations.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has 747 BC hostels and has set up the Swarnakara Welfare and Development Corporation. The EWS department brings together specified EWS-related corporations, not only BC corporations.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise institutional scope and reject the restrictive word ‘only’.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Under G.O. 1065 of August 2026, the reservation for Backward Classes in urban local body polls in Andhra Pradesh is:
accepted.x: G.O. 1065 of August 2026 provides for 33.33 percent BC reservation in urban local body polls.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a reservation percentage from the broader BC population share and the rounded legislative demand.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly resolved to seek what proportion of BC seats in legislatures?
accepted.x: The Assembly resolved to seek 33 percent BC seats in legislatures. This is distinct from the 33.33 percent reservation stated for urban local body polls.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the exact ULB reservation figure and the rounded legislative demand.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following corporations is NOT included among the bodies brought together by the EWS department in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The EWS department brings together the Reddy, Kamma, Kapu, Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vysya and EBC corporations. The Swarnakara Welfare and Development Corporation is associated with BC welfare and is not in that listed group.
accepted.tq: Compare the complete membership list and identify the institution belonging to a different welfare category.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh State Minorities Finance Corporation arrangement, the monthly honorarium is respectively:
o: Rs 5,000 for both Imams and Muezzins
Rs 5,000 for Imams and Rs 10,000 for Muezzins
Rs 10,000 for Imams and Rs 5,000 for Muezzins
Rs 10,000 for both Imams and Muezzins
accepted.x: Imams receive Rs 10,000 per month and Muezzins receive Rs 5,000 per month.
accepted.tq: Test the reversed-pair trap by assigning the correct amount to each similar beneficiary category.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: For 2024-25, the Andhra Pradesh State Minorities Finance Corporation earmarked Rs 45 crore for how many masjids?
accepted.x: Rs 45 crore was provided for 4,984 masjids in 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Separate the masjid count from the much larger student-beneficiary figure associated with scholarships.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched with the Christian Finance Corporation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Jerusalem pilgrimage aid — Rs 60,000; pastors’ honorarium — Rs 5,000
Jerusalem pilgrimage aid — Rs 5,000; pastors’ honorarium — Rs 60,000
Jerusalem pilgrimage aid — Rs 45,000; pastors’ honorarium — Rs 10,000
Jerusalem pilgrimage aid — Rs 10,000; pastors’ honorarium — Rs 5,000
accepted.x: The Christian Finance Corporation provides Rs 60,000 as Jerusalem pilgrimage aid and Rs 5,000 as pastors’ honorarium.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure beneficiary-purpose pair and then verify the two amounts.
accepted.sec: Andhra Pradesh BC and minority welfare - BC corporations, minority finance corporation, Imams and Muezzins honorarium  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The last community to be added to the notified list of minorities in India was:
accepted.x: Jains were the last community added to the notified list of minorities, in 2014.
accepted.tq: Apply the FIRST/LAST recall method to the sequence of notified minority communities.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Section 2(c) of the National Commission for Minorities Act has been criticised because it gives the Centre:
o: exclusive power to appoint State minority commissions
power to amend the Constitution without Parliament
accepted.x: Section 2(c) has been criticised as giving the Centre ‘unbridled power’ to notify minorities, raising concerns in the context of T.M.A. Pai.
accepted.tq: Match the statutory provision with the specific constitutional criticism rather than a broader unrelated power.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The debate over national versus State-level identification of minorities is particularly associated with which judgment?
accepted.x: The national-versus-State-level identification debate is associated with the T.M.A. Pai Foundation judgment.
accepted.tq: Use the case-name association technique for a constitutional interpretation issue.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which commission’s report on Christian minorities was accepted in principle by Kerala?
accepted.x: Kerala accepted the J.B. Koshy Commission report on Christian minorities in principle.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the State-specific Christian-minority commission from commissions dealing with DNTs or Muslims.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:

1. The Andhra Pradesh State Minorities Finance Corporation runs post-matric scholarships.
2. Rs 36.34 crore was provided to 50,767 students under the stated 2024-25 data.
3. The scholarship programme is administered by the Christian Finance Corporation.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The AP State Minorities Finance Corporation runs post-matric scholarships and the stated 2024-25 figures are Rs 36.34 crore for 50,767 students. Statement 3 wrongly attributes the programme to the Christian Finance Corporation.
accepted.tq: Check the implementing institution before accepting the numerical details.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs correctly presents the comparative chronology and beneficiary groups of the development finance corporations?

1. NSFDC — 1989 — Scheduled Castes
2. NBCFDC — 1992 — Backward Classes
3. NSTFDC — 2001 — Scheduled Tribes
4. NMDFC — Minorities

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: NSFDC was established in 1989 for Scheduled Castes, NBCFDC in 1992 for Backward Classes, NSTFDC in 2001 for Scheduled Tribes, and NMDFC serves minorities.
accepted.tq: Build the comparison from the beneficiary group first, then verify the year where given.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Arrange the following development finance corporations in chronological order of the years stated for their establishment:

A. NSTFDC
B. NSFDC
C. NBCFDC
D. NMDFC
accepted.x: The order is NSFDC (1989), NBCFDC (1992), NSTFDC (2001), followed by NMDFC, for which no establishment year is specified in the comparison. The sequence tests the three dated bodies followed by the remaining body.
accepted.tq: Place the dated bodies first and use the undated comparative entry only after establishing the known sequence.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: PMJVK — Area development in minority concentration areas
SEED — Denotified, nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes
accepted.x: NMDFC is associated with minorities, not Scheduled Tribes. SEED, PMJVK and NBCFDC are correctly matched with their stated target groups or purpose.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped beneficiary group, a common ‘wrong body’ and ‘wrong membership’ trap.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: A State government is considering a separate policy for Denotified Tribes after concerns about poor implementation of existing support. Which development most directly reflects this concern?
o: A demand for a special DNT policy in Vijayawada
Expansion of PMJVK to 112 Aspirational Districts
accepted.x: A special DNT policy was demanded in Vijayawada in the context of concerns affecting Denotified Tribes.
accepted.tq: Match the policy demand to the affected community rather than to a similarly timed minority or BC development.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The merger of separate minority schemes into PM VIKAS has been criticised mainly because it:
o: reduced the number of minority communities notified by the Centre
made separate minority schemes lose visibility
accepted.x: The criticism is that separate minority schemes lost visibility after being merged into PM VIKAS.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise criticism rather than converting a visibility concern into abolition or termination.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
